papers.s1: A fair, clean short test of lessons 1-3: each lesson gets a similar share in every part, and the listening is free of defects. It is on the easy side. Two vocabulary fills offer wrong options of a different word class from the answer, which makes them giveaways, and the hand-writing draws three of its four words from lesson 3 and none from lesson 1. The remaining faults are small: one judge relies on inference, and one sentence and one exchange come back in a later part.
papers.final: Much improved and close to a real exam: listening and vocabulary are essentially clean, and the heavy cross-part leaking of round 2 is gone. The faults left are concentrated in grammar and reading: two grammar points are tested twice in the same part (最, 有点儿, the latter with identical options), reading prints two clauses twice ('生日快乐！这是…送给你的', '你穿得太少了'), and three replies have a second acceptable answer. Hand-writing is uneven: four of its 13 words come from lesson 3, and lessons 7-10, 12 and 15 have none, while lessons 7-9 are otherwise well covered.

findings.reason: '你几点___？' needs a verb; the wrong options 药 (noun), 高 (adjective) and 每 (determiner) are all a different type, so only 起床 can fit.
findings.suggest: Offer other verbs that fail on meaning or grammar, e.g. 起床 / 知道 / 跑步 / 休息 checked so only one fits with 几点, or use '你每天几点___？' with 睡觉 excluded.

findings.reason: '这是我的___。' needs a noun; 送, 真 and 一下 are a verb, an adverb and a measure phrase, leaving only 房间.
findings.suggest: Fill wrong options must share the answer's word class; for this stem any noun fits, so make the stem specific (e.g. '这是我女儿的___，很漂亮。') or drop it from fill.

findings.reason: '我看___。' has no context, so '我看一点儿' (read a little) is acceptable alongside '我看一下'.
findings.suggest: Give context such as '这本书很好，你给我看___。' or '让我看___。', and never offer 一点儿 with 一下 on a bare stem.

findings.reason: '他这几天很忙，没有时间休息' does not say he is tired, so '他最近很累' being 对 is an inference.
findings.suggest: Change the claim to '他这几天没有休息。' (对) or '他这几天不忙。' (错).

findings.reason: The passage repeats Q34's judge text '他很忙，没有时间休息' in the same reading part; Q34's text answers Q41 ('Why doesn't he rest?') outright.
findings.suggest: Deduplicate at clause level within a paper, not only whole sentences.

findings.reason: The prompt '你觉得什么时候去最好？' with the answer '我觉得十月最好' is the same exchange as Q7's audio ('…什么时候去北京旅游最好？/ 十月最好').
findings.suggest: Treat a reply and a listening dialogue from the same source exchange as one use.

findings.reason: '我___喜欢踢足球' tests 最 again right after Q81 '九月去北京旅游___好' (also 最), in the same part with almost the same option set.
findings.suggest: Test each grammar word once per paper, as was intended for vocabulary.

findings.reason: '我看___。' has no context, so '我看一点儿' is also acceptable.
findings.suggest: Give the stem context ('让我看___。') or never offer 一点儿 with 一下 here.

findings.reason: '这件衣服___大' tests 有点儿 immediately after Q89 '我这两天___累', with the same four options (一点儿 / 一些 / 一下 / 有点儿).
findings.suggest: Use 有点儿 once per paper; the no-repeat rule should key on the answer word of blank items.

findings.reason: The text '因为昨天下雨，所以我们都没去' never mentions basketball, so the claim '他们昨天去打篮球了' cannot be checked from the text.
findings.suggest: Change the claim to '他们昨天去了。' (错) or put 打篮球 in the text.

findings.reason: '生日快乐！这是我送给你的。' repeats Q114's judge text '生日快乐！这是送给你的。' in the same reading part.
findings.suggest: Deduplicate at clause level: a judge text and a passage must not share a sentence.

findings.reason: The passage prints '你穿得太少了', the opening clause of Q122's judge text, in the same part.
findings.suggest: Deduplicate at clause level within a paper.

findings.reason: '我也不知道。' is a natural answer to '这件怎么样？' (I'm not sure either), besides '还可以。'.
findings.suggest: Never offer generic all-purpose replies ('我也不知道。', '好啊！') as wrong options for an opinion question.

findings.reason: '因为我生病了。' answers '你怎么不吃了？' at least as well as the marked '我不想吃了。'.
findings.suggest: Never offer a 因为… reply as a wrong option for a 怎么/为什么 question.

findings.reason: '她叫杨笑笑。' is a natural way to answer '你认识她吗？' (implying yes).
findings.suggest: Don't offer a reply that names the person as a wrong option for '认识…吗？'.

findings.reason: '我问老师一下' is as correct as '我问一下老师'.
findings.suggest: Accept both orders for verb + 一下 + person object, or drop the item.

findings.reason: The tile '黑' in Q163, in the same writing part, shows the first character of 'hēisè' (黑色).
findings.suggest: In the writing part, a hand word's characters must not appear on any order tile.

rules: Apply the no-repeat rule at clause level (split on ，。！？) and include judge texts, passages, reply prompts and reply options, so near-copies such as '生日快乐！这是送给你的' and '他很忙，没有时间休息' count as repeats.
In blank items, test each answer word or grammar point at most once per paper (最, 有点儿, 但是, 比); this extends 'each word tested once' to grammar.
For reply items, check every wrong option against the prompt for being a plausible answer: no all-purpose replies ('我也不知道。'), no 因为 answers to 怎么/为什么, and no naming replies to '认识…吗？'.
Fill wrong options must have the answer's word class (noun for a noun slot, verb for a verb slot), and stems that accept any member of that class should be excluded from fill.
Exclude context-free blank stems where near-synonyms compete ('我看___' with 一下/一点儿/一次), and in order items accept both positions of 一下 with a person object.
Spread hand-writing words across lessons (at most two per lesson in the final, every lesson at least once in small tests), and keep their characters off the same part's order tiles.
A judge claim must be decidable from the text alone; reject claims that bring in facts not in the text (打篮球) or that need an inference (busy → tired).
